purpose: Test whether Keymaster/Pivot-Slime current-residual structural shortlist plus exact one-step lookahead can rescue canonical C025 OPEN cases without ever overwriting a canonical decisive result.

donor_laws: learn structural features, never transferable numeric pivot labels
top-k proposals followed by exact verification
keep at least one structurally dissimilar alternate in top-k
exact fit/overflow and exact transition replay remain authority
M2R resource metrics are advisory and exact-receipt grounded

outer_ecology.canonical_SAT_or_UNSAT: return replay-confirmed canonical result; R4 is not invoked
outer_ecology.canonical_OPEN: restart from original CNF under R4 exact-lookahead selector
outer_ecology.reason_memory_disabled: R4 first isolates the exact-lookahead mechanism on a holdout-only cold start; learned memory may be tested only in a separately frozen later gate.

cheap_structural_features.source: Keymaster pivot feature microscope pre-elimination plane
forbidden: local numeric pivot id as transferable feature
exact pair enumeration during cheap shortlist formation

shortlist.view_2_conflict_cancellation: maximum single_conflict_mass_per_pair, ties by lower parent_pairs then canonical_index

view_3_structural_diversity.normalization: within-current-residual min-max to [0,1], zero range contributes 0
view_3_structural_diversity.selection: maximum Manhattan distance from anchor across normalized axes, ties by canonical_index

shortlist.deduplication: preserve first occurrence of each pivot; if fewer than four unique views exist, shortlist may be smaller

for_each_shortlisted_pivot: charge the same proposal, pair and certificate-discovery ledger work as stock first_capped_elimination
if elimination returns a candidate, independently run unchanged verify_elimination_transition
charge the same verification ledger work as stock first_capped_elimination
only verified successful candidates are eligible for selection
selection_among_verified_candidates: certificate_readiness_tier: 0 if post-state contains empty clause or every clause width <=2, else 1
lower exact raw_units from elimination stats
exact_lookahead.if_no_shortlisted_candidate_fits: return None to unchanged macro/fail-closed machinery

feature_work_accounting.literal_updates: sum over each current literal contribution to its pivot structural counters
feature_work_accounting.R4_total_fallback_work: R4 exact solver paid_work (which includes all exact lookahead attempts) + R4 feature_work

algorithm: Start with connectivity backbone i=1..8 on supports [i,i+1,i+2] with independent rng.getrandbits(1) signs.
Sample three distinct variables uniformly from 1..10 with independent signs until 42 unique canonical non-tautological width-3 clauses exist.
Canonical literal order is (abs(literal), literal<0); preserve insertion order.
No R1/R2/R3 result, SAT result, Keymaster score, or previous holdout output participates in generation.
